summary: Bluejay Diagnostics filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of pre-funded warrants, Series G warrants, and Series H warrants to purchase common stock, with gross proceeds of roughly $7.7 million after placement-agent fees. The combined price was $2.324 per unit, with exercise prices of $0.0001 (pre-funded) and $2.075 (Series G/H). H.C. Wainwright acted as placement agent. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructure.
